## Load data

```{r cars}
ad <- read_csv("data/act_data.csv")

xd <- read_csv("data/crossact_data.csv")
xd_code <- read_csv("data/Crossact_codebook.csv")
```

## Examine training

```{r, echo=FALSE}
ad_s <- ad %>% filter(subject=="p101")
table(ad_s$trial_type)
#  fam-learning familiar-test      learning          test 
#            4             2            16            16 

ad_fam_train <- ad %>% filter(trial_type=="fam-learning") # trial_index 1-4
# available_image1 - 4
ad_fam_train %>% select(starts_with('available_image')) # always bear cow penguin pig? 

ad_fam_test <- ad %>% filter(trial_type=="familiar-test") # trial_index 5-6
# choice_image, target_image, foil_image


ad_learn <- ad %>% filter(trial_type=="learning")

ad_test <- ad %>% filter(trial_type=="test") # trial_index 15-22, 31-38
# choice_image, target_image, foil_image  (2AFC) -- and test_audio




```

Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.
